correctness.rationale: The tensor-product weighted heat kernel gives a sign-definite potential for each source direction. Every parallel-edge absolute current sums to one, and each transverse direction j contributes precisely sqrt(w_iw_j)/(w_i+w_j), establishing q_i without hidden sign cancellation. A Walsh/Laplace subset expansion yields diagonal r_i, so complement column sum is 1+q_i−2r_i. For w_i=ρ^(2(i−1)), the symmetric decreasing kernel 1/(ρ^h+ρ^(−h)) makes q_i strictly unimodal at center; r_i strictly grows with conductance, leaving only directions 1 and 2 as cycle contenders for d=4. Exact symbolic reduction of p_1−p_2 to (ρ²−1)F(ρ)/H(ρ), gcd(F,F′)=1, and Sturm sign variations [13,13,12,12,12,11,11,11] certify precisely two positive roots above 1 with the asserted sign sequence. Independent exact grounded Laplacian reconstruction on all 12 columns of a genuinely fractional geometric 3-cube and separate degree-24 Sturm arithmetic corroborated both normalizations and all root counts.
residual_risks: Finite 3D rational samples do not prove the general d weighted heat-kernel statement; the product-kernel integration supplies the proof.

originality.rationale: Dilworth–Kutzarova–Ostrovskii (full text) establishes the unweighted Hamming-cube values (Theorem 45 and Corollary 60), a strict specialization w_i all equal in which direction symmetry forbids any reentrant optimizer transition. The weighted transfer-current spectral-bound theorem of Gurel-Gurevich–Nachmias–Sachdeva is about ||abs(Q)||_2 and does not specify the exact max absolute column sum of Q, its complement, or the 4D direction phase. General electrical flow formulas are acknowledged. Resultary searches found unrelated unweighted Walsh projections, not equivalent weighted cycle direction classification; implicit older network formulas remain possible.
residual_risks: Historical unindexed or uninspected literature may contain an equivalent or stronger statement; a failed search alone does not prove novelty.

value.rationale: The pairwise-weight q_i expression and subset r_i sum are sharp all-dimension endpoint invariants for canonical normalized electrical projections, replacing exponentially sized matrices by tractable explicit formulas. The exact 1→2→1 cycle-maximizer reentrance under monotone geometric conductance is a natural structural counterexample to intuitive monotonicity.
residual_risks: The d=4 reentrant classification does not claim a high-dimensional phase diagram or nonorthogonal projection minimality.

final_claim: For Boolean cubes with arbitrary positive direction-constant conductances, exact canonical cut/cycle endpoint norms are the maxima of q_i=1+Σ_{j≠i}sqrt(w_iw_j)/(w_i+w_j) and p_i=1+q_i−2r_i with r_i a finite subset resistance sum. For geometric weights, cut maximizers are central coordinates in every d, while d=4 cycle maximizers switch 1→2→1 at exactly two isolated ratios.
